samples.text: Floating-point addition is not associative because the order in which you add numbers can change the result due to rounding errors. For example, (1.1 + 2.2) + 3.3 can be computed as 3.3 + (1.1 + 2.2) if the intermediate result is rounded to a different value. This can lead to different final results, demonstrating that floating-point addition is not associative.
